title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.003665731276 (+>3.607758e-7 over #7626, common U)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Ports DreamingOfClouds' #7621 courier for roles 1445/1461 and helper-226 re-stop onto #7626. The source-specific early encoding follows the owned1506 write at source clock 34163; the actual wrong-anchor mutant fails paired exact replay.

The source-bound execution and separate read-only AI receipt/economic reviews support **conditional κ ≥ 0.003665731276**, exactly `916432819/250000000000`. Against #7626's full upper `25188234281719/6871947673600000`, the exact gain is

`193690033746837/536870912000000000000 > 3.607758e-7`.

This changes the complete signed 17-call paid profile by `{1:+17, 2:+17, 3:-51, 6:+17}`, with unchanged targets, 110,043 paid children and rank surplus 1,424. The native word grows from 77,371 to 77,373 events: 17 deletions, 19 insertions, two added ADDs and unchanged MOVEs. The extra work is charged. The fixed signed-invoice crossing is approximately 0.00366573127736793468, about 1.367934678834e-12 above the conservative claim; extra digits of that same root are not another gain.

**The common U is unimplemented.** It is assumed for both actual source/candidate words with the same parameterized tariff and bounds: entire private extent and reachable residuals; atomic nonaliasing return; the full already-charged 4,000-unit lifecycle item including nonreset work; 32 scalar services per INIT/CLEAR at normalized coefficient 2^20; all original size, width and precision factors; context cap 4096. All five inherited framework assumptions remain. No actual U provider, original-premise implication, same-original-premise dominance, unconditional multiplier theorem or selected-frontier admission is established.

## Task and overlap

Scope **refines** `p104-side-correction` to this fixed two-component port and joint word. Base/current observed main is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Exact predecessors:

- #7626: `5987b208bc05d066f01f800a3d88538cb216eccd`.
- #7621: `0ddef5c67b90bc4e9561186a435b44a46f49a0b1`.
- #7624: `3f231831e0bff0cc5241ec89e122d99132bddf52`.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19649777). Its original lease has expired; this PR is the fixed-scope delivery artifact and reserves no broad courier/loan domain. Latest 40 open PRs and implicated heads were refreshed before publication; no newer exact port appeared in that bounded view. Earlier targeted all-state/comments and Discussion checks are retained. The mechanisms and all preceding gains retain their original credit. The #7621 intake is eight text files, not a full reproduction of its sixteen-file source closure.

## Validation

- Independent 1,569-symbol Fraction replay of source and all three variants; 204 CLEARs, 700 protected owned interfaces, 455 owned stream events, one COPY, 68 labels and peak 50. Normal/optimized source-free controls, eight actual mutations and two directed provisional price engines passed. First gate: 164.47 seconds.
- Both fresh 204-certificate sets and complete native stage: 1,085 unique expected chart pairs, 512 forward and 512 adjoint columns with absolute phase, finite physical replay, signed routes and required negative controls. Native: 1,864.214 seconds.
- Separately approved signed/resource completion:all 3,112 contiguous protected-generator catalogue cases, 104 boundaries, 54 strict plus 4 functional public-claim predicates, complete 17-call invoices, both directed prices and the ordinary/precision/tape/resource conjunction. Signed 509.935 seconds; resources 0.917 seconds. Controller 513.832 seconds verified release, empty group and archived known audit. One CPU, 2 GiB, no swap, 1,200 seconds, no automatic retry.

The original full service ended without final controller/resource/audit receipts. Cause, total cost and final cleanup remain unknown. Its partial/raw evidence is retained unchanged. The completion reuses actual original native/certificate receipts byte-for-byte; it does not relabel them as fresh. Job `qualified_kappa=false` remains intact; the combined conditional conclusion comes from separate receipt/economic review. This is not one cold full replay or independent scientific execution.

Signed ordinary is 791,362,412→791,363,500, including 1,088 additional scalar services. Common precision is 2,430; candidate margin to 10^9 is 208,636,500. All assumed U work remains required; a provider exceeding any tariff/envelope would require a new fully charged application.

The archive contains 565 files, 564 PINS entries, 766 mapped original paths and 501 deduplicated objects. It binds the original 450 and continuation 603 freezes plus 44 interrupted raw records and retains all nested notices. Normal/optimized artifact/materialization controls passed 64 checks, including 15 mutation cases. A clean byte-only materialization and all nine prospective exact-replay input bindings passed.

These commands passed on the published head:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-courier-restop-on7626 --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-courier-restop-on7626
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-courier-restop-on7626 --check-modes
```

Registered VERIFY checks artifact identity, not science. The materializer does not relocate historical absolute paths or run a cold scientific replay. The exact-only reviewer recipe is prospective and unexecuted from the export. Source-seven checks derive from paired native calculations, not a standalone source-native/source-catalogue rerun. Catalogue completeness is relative to its protected generator, without an independent inventory oracle. The inherited six changed #7624 exact-Q erasure forms remain a separate original-applicability issue; exact owned/CLEAR forms are unchanged relative to #7626. AI receipt review is not human/formal acceptance; total 30-agent and interrupted-window costs are unmeasured.

## Open next questions

Request independent substantive/common-model review and **conditional frontier-eligibility review if the explicit U is accepted**. First inspect the fixed word, paired exact/phase evidence and complete invoices; then determine whether the whole private-state/lifecycle/precision contract can be implemented or derived from the original premise. No merge, closure of others' work or selected-record change is requested.
